user.title: Connect TapHome Core
user.description: Expose your devices in the TapHome app (Settings → Expose devices → TapHome API) and enter the token below. A local connection is recommended: only enable "Use TapHome cloud" if you can't reach the Core directly on your network — the cloud updates less often (about every 20 seconds) and depends on TapHome's servers being reachable. Find your Core's IP address in the TapHome app under "My location".

data.use_description_as_entity_id: Use TapHome descriptions as entity IDs
data.use_description_as_name: Use TapHome descriptions as entity names

data_description.token: Authorization token shown at the top of the TapHome API screen.
data_description.use_cloud: Connect through the TapHome cloud instead of your local network. Only recommended when the Core is not reachable locally — the cloud is slower and requires an internet connection. The IP address is ignored when enabled.
data_description.ip: Find it in the TapHome app under My location.
data_description.id: Optional identifier for this Core. Only needed when you use more than one Core.
data_description.webhook_id: Recommended: lets the Core push updates instantly instead of Home Assistant polling every 2 seconds. Enter any name, e.g. taphome_primary, then in the TapHome app on the Expose devices screen enable Webhook and set the Webhook URL to e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123/api/webhook/taphome — replace homeassistant.local with your own Home Assistant address and taphome_primary with the name you entered above.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure TapHome Core
reconfigure.description: Update the connection and Core settings of your TapHome Core. A local connection is recommended: only enable "Use TapHome cloud" if you can't reach the Core directly on your network — the cloud updates less often (about every 20 seconds) and depends on TapHome's servers being reachable. Find your Core's IP address in the TapHome app under "My location".

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Map TapHome zones to Home Assistant areas. Pick the area for each zone; leave a zone empty to not assign an area.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Map TapHome categories to Home Assistant labels. Pick the label for each category; leave a category empty to not assign a label.

add_devices.title: Add devices
add_devices.description: Pick the TapHome devices you want to add. Type in the field to search. Devices that are not added yet show their TapHome zone and category, added devices show their room.

data_description.clear_selection: Turn on and press Next to clear the whole selection, then pick only the devices you want.

add_devices_platform.title: Select domains
add_devices_platform.description: For each device, choose the Home Assistant domains to expose it as. You can pick several domains per device, or none to skip the device. Only domains compatible with the device are offered.

add_devices_options.title: Device options
add_devices_options.description: Set the options for each selected device and domain. Each section is one device on one domain. Empty fields use automatic defaults.
